title: 创意款 · 成分科普

shots.visual_description: Macro close-up of skin, then animated graphic of 'melanin' particles appearing and dissolving with a 'zap' sound effect. Dramatic, high-tech lighting.
shots.narration: 你知道吗？皮肤暗沉，其实是黑色素在作祟！但别怕，我们有秘密武器！

shots.visual_description: Animated graphic transition from skin texture to a stylized molecular structure (e.g., Niacinamide or Vitamin C derivative), with scientific labels. Clean, laboratory-style lighting.
shots.narration: 今天，就带你揭秘这款美白面霜的核心成分，它能精准狙击黑色素！

shots.visual_description: Product hero shot, with animated lines pointing from the product to various key ingredients listed on screen. Soft, glowing light highlighting product and ingredients.
shots.narration: 这款美白面霜，凝聚尖端科技，将有效成分完美融合，层层焕亮肌肤。

shots.visual_description: Close-up of the cream's luxurious, pearl-like texture being spread smoothly on the back of a hand, showing its quick absorption and non-greasy finish. Bright, clean lighting.
shots.narration: 轻盈不粘腻，深入肌底，从源头抑制黑色素生成，让肌肤透出健康白皙。

shots.visual_description: A split-screen showing a 'microscopic' view: left side shows dense, dark melanin clusters, right side shows them visibly reduced and scattered after 'applying' the cream. Scientific, blue-toned lighting.
shots.narration: 看！黑色素被有效抑制，肌肤屏障也得到修护，美白更温和持久！

shots.visual_description: Model looking confident and radiant, her skin glowing with an even, bright complexion. A subtle 'before/after' overlay showing a gradual brightening effect over time. Bright, aspirational lighting.
shots.narration: 不止表面白，更是由内而外的通透亮白，让你自信迎接每一天！

shots.visual_description: Product array with the face cream as the centerpiece, surrounded by glowing light. Text overlay: '成分党挚爱，立即体验！' with a QR code or 'Shop Now' button. Futuristic, clean lighting.
shots.narration: 成分党们，这款美白面霜绝对不会让你失望！点击下方，立即拥有它！
shots.text_overlay: 成分党首选！点击立即购买！
